_comment: Shared listing copy for every directory. Keep in sync with server.json and the Apify Store page.
name: YouTube Transcript API
tagline: Transcripts + metadata from YouTube videos, Shorts, channels, playlists and search; text/SRT/VTT.
description: YouTube transcripts with timestamps and metadata from videos, Shorts, playlists, channels or search, in bulk. 12/12 in our head-to-head test, with zero failures charged. Flags auto vs human captions. Text, LLM-ready text, SRT, VTT. Videos without captions never charged.
whenToChoose: You need transcripts from many sources in one call: videos, Shorts, playlists, channels (@handle, /channel/UC..., /shorts and /streams tabs) and YouTube search terms, de-duplicated.

You need only recent or new uploads: maxVideosPerSource (newest first), publishedAfter/publishedBefore (exact upload dates) and onlyNewVideos, which on a schedule returns only videos published since the last run.

You need to know what you got: language, isAutoGenerated, originalLanguage, availableLanguages and requestedLanguageFound on every record. Human-made tracks in any English variant (en-GB, en-US) are picked before auto captions; if the requested language is missing, the original language is returned and flagged.

You need several formats at one price: paragraph text, llmText ([Music], (laughs), ♪ and >> markers removed), timestamped segments, SRT and WebVTT, plus metadata (subscribers, views, likes, comment count, publish date, duration, tags).

You need to pay only for delivered transcripts: no captions, captions not ready yet (uploads under 24 h), deleted, private, live, invalid, blocked and over-budget videos come back as free rows with errorType, retryable and hint. maxTotalChargeUsd stops cleanly as SUCCEEDED (cloud-tested 18 Oct 2026).

Accuracy check (Apify cloud, 18 Oct 2026): transcripts matched YouTube's own caption tracks word for word and timestamp for timestamp on 18 videos (2-hour podcasts, Shorts, Spanish, music, AI-voice channels) and 28/28 tracks in the head-to-head. Scale test: 299 of 300 videos from 6 large channels delivered; the miss had no captions.

Head-to-head (our test, Apify cloud, 18 Oct 2026, 12 identical cases against the 5 most-used YouTube transcript Actors in the Store plus codepoetry/youtube-transcript-ai-scraper): 12/12 expected outcomes and 0 charged failures; the five most-used tools scored 7-9/12 and 4 of them charged for at least one failure. Fastest whole-batch run (30 videos in 39 s).
comparison: Per their Apify Store pages on 18 Oct 2026: pintostudio/youtube-transcript-scraper charges $0.010 per dataset row and takes one video per run; starvibe/youtube-video-transcript charges $0.005 per dataset row, including rows for errors. This tool charges only its 'transcript' event ($0.008 Free, $0.005 Gold+), so failed videos and empty runs cost nothing.
chooseAnotherToolWhen: You need transcripts of videos that have no captions at all (speech-to-text; codepoetry/youtube-transcript-ai-scraper offers AI transcription per minute), the text of comments, age-restricted or members-only videos, or machine translation into a language the video has no captions in. For the lowest possible per-row price on captioned videos, several Store Actors charge $0.001-0.003.
auth: OAuth (sign in with Apify) or header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>
